verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot documents 'Access to Cloud agent and code review' and Autofix providing 'contextual explanations and code suggestions to help developers fix vulnerabilities,' indicating a code review capability exists, but the evidence pack lacks detail on how automatic PR review triggers, its scope/accuracy, or independent hands-on validation of PR-review quality. Missing for 10: detailed docs on automatic PR review workflow/triggers, independent/hands-on evidence of review quality and false-positive rates, and coverage beyond vulnerability-focused Autofix.
